title: Refund an order — refuse refunds after it closes
narrative: A paid order can be refunded; KIFF allows a partial refund and signs a receipt. The app tracks the running total and, when it reaches the order amount, marks the order fully refunded. After that, KIFF refuses every further refund — a closed order can't be reopened. KIFF enforces the terminal state; the app owns the arithmetic.

steps.description: The agent issues a partial refund. Allowed — the order is PAID. Signed receipt.
The app records the partial refund (state → PARTIALLY_REFUNDED).
The app's running total reaches the order amount and closes the order (state → FULLY_REFUNDED).
Another refund is attempted on the closed order. KIFF refuses it (state_not_allowed). Signed refusal.
